mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, files, chat_id, prompt, system_prompt, content, model_id, create_time FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY chat_id ORDER BY create_time DESC) AS rn FROM chat_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ) AS t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{start}, #{limit}
SELECT id, user_id, files, chat_id, prompt, system_prompt content, think_content, response_content, model_id, create_time FROM chat_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} and chat_id = #{chatId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by create_time desc

SELECT id, type, api_key as apiKey, model_name as modelName, base_url as baseUrl, disabled, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM chat_model WHERE id = #{modelId} AND company_id = #{companyId} AND (disabled = 0 OR disabled IS NULL)

SELECT cd.*, CASE WHEN cd.directory_id = 'default' THEN '默认文件夹' ELSE cdd.DIRECTORY END AS directory_name FROM chat_doc cd LEFT JOIN chat_doc_directory cdd ON cd.directory_id = cdd.id LEFT JOIN tenant dt ON dt.id = cd.tenant_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE ( (cd.permission = 'tenant' AND cd.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) OR (cd.permission = 'company' AND dt.company_id = #{companyId}) ) ORDER BY cd.create_time DESC
SELECT company_id FROM tenant WHERE id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM chat_doc WHERE id = #{docId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_doc WHERE id = #{docId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_doc SET permission = #{permission}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{docId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, tenant_id, directory, create_time, update_time FROM chat_doc_directory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_doc_directory( id, user_id, tenant_id, directory, create_time, update_time ) SELECT #{id}, #{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{directory}, NOW(), NOW() FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chat_doc_directory WHERE directory = #{directory} AND user_id = #{userId} ) AND ( #{userId} = #{tenantId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tenant_user tu INNER JOIN tenant t ON tu.tenant_id = t.id INNER JOIN user u ON tu.user_id = u.id WHERE tu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tu.user_id = #{userId} AND tu.disabled = 0 AND t.status = 1 AND u.disabled = 0 ) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, tenant_id as tenantId, directory, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM chat_doc_directory WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_doc_directory SET directory = #{directory}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}

mapper.update: UPDATE chat_model SET type = #{type}, api_key = #{apiKey}, model_name = #{modelName}, base_url = #{baseUrl}, disabled = #{disabled, jdbcType=INTEGER}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND company_id = #{companyId}
